en: Color image of a ski resort scene in the mountains. In the foreground many children and some adults are skiing and learning on a gentle snowy slope with a rope tow. Most wear bright 1960s–1970s style ski clothing. In the mid‑ground there are long, low chalet-style lodge buildings with dark red/brown wood and white-trim windows, plus another small lift building on the right. Evergreen trees surround the runs, and high, snowy mountains rise in the background under a clear blue sky. A faint circular violet postal cancel mark is visible near the center top of the card.
